verdict.rationale: NetHunt's homepage claims it can build customer profiles with verified contact details. That suggests some first-party contact-data enrichment, but it is a single thin marketing line. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic enrichment or firmographic company data. missing for 10: documented automatic enrichment of contact and company records, firmographic data (industry, size, revenue) for companies, enrichment sources and coverage details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data

citations.quote: Build comprehensive customer profiles with verified contact details.
